BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, gibbâr means mighty one, might. It occurs just once, in Daniel.
TheologicalSignificance: I read gibbâr plainly: mighty one, might, and I leave it there.
RelatedEvents: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace
